item.description: Thursday September 10th ZACK KEIM x GARDENER w/ THE DUSKWHALES, STEPHEN SOL \*\*\* ZACK KEIM His second solo album, titled “Battery Lane” is out now via Evan Westfall of Caamp’s indie label Super Sport Records. Named after the street where Keim lived during his time in the DC area, the album reflects the people and places that inspired this chapter of his songwriting. From 2025 to 2026, he toured extensively throughout the US/Europe/and UK. Keim's powerful live performances have led him to play SXSW and share the stage with renowned artists such as Peter Case (The Nerves/Plimsouls), indie icon Calvin Johnson (Beat Happening/founder of K Records), and acclaimed singer-songwriter Matt Costa. His standout single, “Better Days,” has received praise from Sirius XMU calling it “a fun, fuzzy, classic.” GARDENER Hailing from Yellow Springs, OH, Gardener is a close-knit group of old friends. Their music paints vivid sonic landscapes, blending raw Americana with dreamy, country-tinged indie rock

item.title: Spoonfed (EP Release Show) — Fri Sep 25, 7:00 PM — Songbyrd
item.description:
Spoonfed is a Washington, D.C.-based rock band consisting of Will Sevy (vocals/guitar), Kevin Cox (bass), and Kieran O'Dell (vocals/drums). Formed in 2021 in the basement of their house in Charlottesville, Virginia, Spoonfed has grown from late-night jam sessions into one of the DMV's emerging indie bands. Spoonfed draws inspiration from the grunge rock of the 1990s, the alt-rock of the early 2000s, and the grooves of modern funk. Expect energy: dark and uplifting melodies, dynamic rhythms, moody lyrics, guitar solos. Their debut EP drops September 16.
Source: Songbyrd

item.description: Before the world knew her name, they knew her pen. Jozzy is the Diamond certified, three time Grammy nominated singer songwriter from Memphis, Tennessee, whose catalog has generated over two billion streams across credits for Beyoncé, SZA, Summer Walker, Lil Nas X, Drake, Metro Boomin, Mary J. Blige, and dozens more. She co wrote the Billy Ray Cyrus verse that turned "Old Town Road" into the fastest Diamond certified song in RIAA history. She gave Beyoncé "Virgo's Groove." She penned Summer Walker's "Body" and SZA's "Low." She scored Spider Man: Across the Spider Verse. Raised in the lineage of Memphis soul royalty, her mother sang alongside Al Green and Ann Peebles at Hi Records. Jozzy honed her craft under the mentorship of Timbaland and Missy Elliott before becoming one of the most commercially impactful writers of her generation. item.title: Guerilla Toss — Tue Oct 20, 7:00 PM — Songbyrd
item.description: When NYC-based experimental dance punks Guerilla Toss, active since time immemorial aka 2011, were in Vermont recording their new full-length album You’re Weird Now, frontwoman Kassie Carlson would prepare what she called ‘punk lunch’: a communal meal made by raiding the studio fridge for whatever was left and assembling a sandwich from the most random ingredients imaginable. Regularly joining punk lunch were two legends from their own corners of the weird music world: Stephen Malkmus (Pavement, The Jicks) and Trey Anastasio, Phish guitarist and owner of The Barn; the recording studio where Guerilla Toss were making You’re Weird Now, with Malkmus in the producer’s seat. Engineer Bryce Goggin, who has worked with Malkmus since Crooked Rain, Crooked Rain, and Ben Collette, Phish’s longtime engineer at The Barn, were also part of the crew. item.description: Sunday October 25th Renny Conti w/ James Eichman \*\*\* Through his early twenties, Renny self-released a string of homemade albums, sorting out his aesthetic and narrative viewpoint as a musician before his project began in earnest. His self-titled debut was recorded in 2023, collecting older material that served as a proper introduction to him as an artist. Finally released in 2025, the album soon earned him buzz across the indie landscape, and landed him a deal with Mom+Pop. Once more, Split Second feels like a long-awaited debut: Emerging from not only 2023 but all the years before, Split Second catalogues the snapshots and places and people that made Renny the musician he is today. Renny’s life in music began as it does for many of us: a means of escape from the confusing pivot from childhood to teenage years. item.description: Saturday October 24th Songbyrd x U+N Booking Present Swapmeet is a 4-piece band from South Australia composed of Venus O’Broin (guitar, vocals), Joshua Doherty (bass), Maxwell Elphick (guitar, drums, vocals), and Jack Medlyn (guitar, drums, vocals). Having recently caught the ear of American indie label Winspear, the band is readying their debut album and offering a taste of the new material with “I Know!”, a cathartic and buoyant debut single for their new label home. Revved up with gleaming, fuzzy guitars and energetic percussion, the new track blurs jangle pop, shoegaze, and alt-rock with tongue-in-cheek precision. The group met as teenagers in the early 2020s while playing in various projects around the Adelaide music scene and bonded over their love of 90s alternative, citing Pavement and Sonic Youth as early influences.
